text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Japanese Oaks…

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Fan A
text_block_list.text: It's starting! The morning special on Yukino Bijin is about to start!

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Fan B
text_block_list.text: They pre-recorded a segment, right? Hopefully we'll get a behind-the-scenes look at our angel's daily life. ♪

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text: We're here today at Tokyo Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text: It feels like a festival out in the stands! And you'll see why in just a little bit, so don't turn that channel!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: H-hey there! I'm Yukino Bijin!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: T-this cam'ra's gonna be on me like white on rice today, so let's have a good time!

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Fans
text_block_list.text: Oooh! She's so cute! She really is an angel!

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text: This young Umamusume from Morioka, Yukino Bijin—but you might know her as the Snow Angel—is the talk of the town!

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text: And it's not just for her pretty face. We've get a special video of her training, so let's take a first-hand look at her incredible grit!

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Fan A
text_block_list.text: W-wait a sec! Did they just say "grit"?

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Fan B
text_block_list.text: Is that supposed to describe Yukino? There's no way…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Now I'll show you my usual run!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: HHHRAAAUUGH!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… And last but not least, I'm gonna lift 350 kilos!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ngh… Gaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Fan A
text_block_list.text: I… I had no idea Yukino was such a monster… She always comes across so ethereal.

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yeah. It's almost like… too much.

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Fan B
text_block_list.text: I guess she's not who we thought…

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Yukinooo!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y-yikes!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um… Thanks for cheer'n for me, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: SQUEEE! So cute! Good luck out there!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Please step back and make some space before someone gets hurt!

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, this is wild. When did Yukino Bijin get so popular?

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan A
text_block_list.text: This Triple Tiara tour feels a bit different than usual.

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan B
text_block_list.text: I just hope the craziness doesn't throw Harp Alpha off her game…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's another racer many are expecting to win the Tiara tour, and many diehard racing fans are big supporters.

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan B
text_block_list.text: She might be on the quiet side, but you can feel her passion. I bet she even has what it takes to win the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan B
text_block_list.text: Here's hoping she can keep shining, keep winning, and become a star!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah, not again…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Must be nice… I wish people'd talk about me that way…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I notice something off about Yukino Bijin before the race. At first, I think it's just nerves, but…

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Hold on a sec, Harp Alpha! Let me check your cleats one last time.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Harp Alpha
text_block_list.text: You've already checked them like a million times today. They're fine.

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Sorry, but you know how weak your legs are. Your cleats have to be perfect if you're going to keep running for years to come.

text_block_list.name: Harp Alpha
text_block_list.text: …Why do you believe in me so much?

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Because I know what you're capable of. Your fans do too. Their support proves how spectacular you are.

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Now, get out there and win. Become a star we can all wish upon.

text_block_list.name: Harp Alpha
text_block_list.text: …Of course. No one shines brighter than me, after all.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But if she's a star, what does that make me?
choice_data_list: (Looks like Yukino has found herself a rival.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin's eyes follow Harp Alpha as she walks off. I can tell by her face that she's thinking she wants to surpass her.
choice_data_list: You want to beat her, don't you?
You want to beat her, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: OHHH!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That must be it! That's what this feel'n is…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I guess not… It's like… I've never felt like this b'fore.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: 'Course I know that races are all about winn'n and los'n…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But now… Now it's like someth'n's boil'n up inside of me…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I wanna hear people cheer'n me on like that—hear 'em tell'n me I got what it takes to win. Guess that means I wanna beat her, huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …I wanna win.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I wanna beat her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin's eyes blaze like a roaring fire.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I feel like something'll change if I beat her.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I don't know what exactly… and at the end of the day, she might come out on top…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But still! Even if she does…
choice_data_list: I know you have what it takes. Besides…
I know you have what it takes. Besides…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes?
choice_data_list: I'm always cheering for you to win.
I'm always cheering for you to win.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
choice_data_list: So go out there and do it!
So go out there and do it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Get ready for me t'bring back the gold!
